_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values so extracted.

flights.basis: real drone flights in the public dataset

spoofed.basis: flights flown under controlled spoofing attacks

held_out.basis: whole flights set aside for testing, unseen in training

trained.basis: flights - held_out, the flights left for training

readings.basis: consecutive readings the best model was given

score_pct.basis: Chronos's score on one measure balancing caught abnormal stretches against correct alerts, never accuracy

grant_about.basis: about this many dollars of NSF funding, printed with about, never drawn

team_ug.basis: undergraduate research assistants on the team

team_grad.basis: graduate research assistants on the team
